review.reviewNotes: Six distinct complete right-facing overhead-pass poses. Moxie’s pale skin, lavender eyes, high lavender ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver kit and human anatomy remain consistent with both canon references. No ball appears. Frame3 is the sole tick7 release; the face stays readable.
